def remove_nth_from_end(head, n):
    length, node = 0, head
    while node:                        # pass 1: count
        length += 1
        node = node.next
    dummy = ListNode(0, head)
    prev = dummy
    for _ in range(length - n):        # pass 2: stop just before the target
        prev = prev.next
    prev.next = prev.next.next
    return dummy.next

def reorder_list(head):
    slow, fast = head, head.next       # 1. find the middle
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow, fast = slow.next, fast.next.next
    second, slow.next = slow.next, None

    prev = None                        # 2. reverse the second half
    while second:
        nxt = second.next
        second.next = prev
        prev, second = second, nxt

    first, second = head, prev         # 3. weave
    while second:
        n1, n2 = first.next, second.next
        first.next = second
        second.next = n1
        first, second = n1, n2

def reorder_list(head):
    nodes = []
    while head:
        nodes.append(head)
        head = head.next
    i, j = 0, len(nodes) - 1
    while i < j:                       # front, back, front, back, …
        nodes[i].next = nodes[j]
        i += 1
        if i == j:
            break
        nodes[j].next = nodes[i]
        j -= 1
    nodes[i].next = None

def reverse_list(head):
    prev, cur = None, head
    while cur:
        nxt = cur.next
        cur.next = prev
        prev, cur = cur, nxt

def reverse_list(head):
    if not head or not head.next:
        return head
    new_head = reverse_list(head.next) # reverse the rest first
    head.next.next = head              # then hang head after its old successor
    head.next = None
    return new_head

def reverse_between(head, left, right):
    dummy = ListNode(0, head)
    before = dummy
    for _ in range(left - 1):
        before = before.next           # node at position left-1
    cur = before.next                  # becomes the tail of the reversed part
    for _ in range(right - left):
        move = cur.next                # head-insert the node after cur
        cur.next = move.next
        move.next = before.next
        before.next = move
    return dummy.next

def reverse_between(head, left, right):
    dummy = ListNode(0, head)
    before = dummy
    for _ in range(left - 1):
        before = before.next
    prev, cur = None, before.next      # reverse right − left + 1 nodes
    for _ in range(right - left + 1):
        nxt = cur.next
        cur.next = prev
        prev, cur = cur, nxt
    before.next.next = cur             # old first node now links to the rest
    before.next = prev                 # before links to the new first node
    return dummy.next
P19-reverse-nodes-in-k-group:
def reverse_k_group(head, k):
    dummy = ListNode(0, head)
    group_prev = dummy
    while True:
        kth = group_prev               # 1. check that k nodes exist
        for _ in range(k):
            kth = kth.next
            if not kth:
                return dummy.next
        group_next = kth.next

        prev, cur = group_next, group_prev.next   # 2. reverse the block
        while cur is not group_next:
            nxt = cur.next
            cur.next = prev
            prev, cur = cur, nxt

        first = group_prev.next        # 3. relink; old first is the new tail
        group_prev.next = kth
        group_prev = first

def reverse_k_group(head, k):
    dummy = tail = ListNode()
    node = head
    while node:
        stack, probe = [], node
        while probe and len(stack) < k:
            stack.append(probe)        # collect up to k nodes
            probe = probe.next
        if len(stack) < k:
            tail.next = node           # short tail: keep its order
            break
        while stack:
            tail.next = stack.pop()    # popping gives reversed order
            tail = tail.next
        tail.next = None
        node = probe
    return dummy.next
